tagline: Protecting what matters. Enabling confidence through integrated insurance and technology solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: Strategic lever for acquisitions, dividends, and financial resilience within an integrated insurance-tech model. Key driver of capex flexibility and shareholder returns.
company_description: Assurant, Inc. provides protection services to connected devices, homes, and automobiles in North America, Latin America, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through Global Lifestyle and Global Housing segments. The Global Lifestyle segment offers mobile device solutions, and extended service contracts and related services for consumer electronics and appliances, and credit and other insurance products; and vehicle protection, commercial equipment protection, and other related services. The Global Housing segment provides lender-placed homeowners, manufactured housing, and flood insurance; renters insurance and other products; and voluntary manufactured housing, and condominium and homeowners insurance products. The company was formerly known as Fortis, Inc. and changed its name to Assurant, Inc. in February 2004. Assurant, Inc. was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.

kpis.name: Holding Company Liquidity
kpis.explanation: Cash available at the holding company to fund acquisitions, dividends, or share repurchases.
kpis.description: Liquidity available at Assurant, Inc. (holding company) after safety reserve. Used for buybacks, dividends, acquisitions.
kpis.signal: High level of strategic liquidity well above minimum.

kpis.name: Dividends from Subsidiaries
kpis.explanation: Net cash flows received by the holding company from insurance subsidiaries.
kpis.description: Net dividends received by the holding company from insurance subsidiaries, essential to fund shareholder return policies and corporate expenses.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in cash flows from subsidiaries.

kpis.name: Stock Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount spent to repurchase outstanding shares, reducing share count.
kpis.description: Share repurchases executed during 2025 (1,432,302 shares at $299.9M), under the authorized repurchase program.
kpis.signal: Acceleration of buybacks despite dividend increase.

kpis.name: Dividend Paid
kpis.explanation: Total amount of dividends paid to common shareholders during the year.
kpis.description: Dividends paid to shareholders, with a 10% increase to $0.88 per share quarterly in Q4 2025.
kpis.signal: 10% increase in quarterly dividend demonstrating confidence in cash flow generation.

kpis.name: Share Repurchase Authorization
kpis.explanation: Total amount authorized by the board to repurchase shares in future periods.
kpis.description: New $700 million authorization in November 2025, in addition to the remaining $600 million from prior authorization.
kpis.signal: New $700M authorization in November 2025 reinforcing commitment to shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Annual dividend amount paid per common share.
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share following increase to $0.88 per quarter at end of 2025 (10% increase).
kpis.signal: Notable increase in dividend per share reflecting improved profitability.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: $12.814B total revenue in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: $0.873B net income in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: DPS
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.

kpis.name: Cap Return
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: $0.168B capital returned to shareholders via dividends in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 19.3% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Dividend Increase
kpis.explanation: Percentage increase in the quarterly dividend upon Q4 2025 announcement.
kpis.description: Quarterly dividend increased from $0.80 to $0.88 in Q4 2025, a 10% increase.
kpis.signal: Increase from $0.80 to $0.88 per share quarterly signaling confidence in cash flow generation.

kpis.name: EPS
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares for the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
